faq.pageDesc: The questions we get asked most, before and after purchase. Open a ticket any time if yours isn't here.

common.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
common.a: Crypto only: USDT / USDC on several networks (TRC20, BEP20, Polygon, ERC20, TON, Solana…) plus TRX — no Alipay / WeChat. After ordering, pick a network on the order page: you'll see the wallet address, a QR code and the exact amount to send.

USDT transfers confirm automatically within about a minute of landing on-chain. Account products deliver instantly after confirmation; top-ups and region changes are handled by our team with live progress in your ticket.

common.q: Why does the amount have to match to the cent?
common.a: The system matches concurrent orders by the amount's decimals. Paying a different amount doesn't lose your money, but it can't be matched automatically — open a support ticket and we'll fix it manually.

common.q: My order expired but I already paid — what now?
common.a: No worries. Late payments are still recognised automatically and the system re-reserves stock and delivers; if stock ran out, it's escalated to us by email for manual re-delivery.

Account products can't be refunded once delivered (credentials already handed over). Top-ups and region changes are fully refundable before work starts; failed jobs are refunded case by case. Contact support to start one.
Log in and use “Ask a question” or “Open a support ticket” on the order page. We get an email instantly; replies show in the ticket and are also emailed to you.

common.q: Can I sign in with Telegram?
common.a: Yes. Email and Telegram can be linked to the same account and share orders and tickets; linking an existing email merges the two accounts automatically.

ACCOUNT.a: Yes — freshly registered, no games, no prior bindings. Exclusively yours after delivery.

ACCOUNT.q: What must I do after receiving it?
ACCOUNT.a: Change the password, switch the email to your own and ideally enable the Steam mobile authenticator. Only then is the account truly yours.
The wallet can only be funded with local payment methods (our top-up service covers that); a few games are region-locked; Steam allows a region change roughly once every 3 months.

TOPUP.q: Do you need my password for a top-up?
TOPUP.a: No. Only your Steam login name (not the nickname) — we fund your wallet through official channels.

TOPUP.q: Do I receive the full face value?
TOPUP.a: Yes, exactly the amount stated on the product, no fees deducted.

TOPUP.q: Can you top up an account from another region?
TOPUP.a: No. Wallet currency is tied to the account region — check your region first or use our region-change service.

REGION_CHANGE.q: Will a region change affect my games?
REGION_CHANGE.a: No. Everything you own stays; only the store pricing region and checkout currency change.

REGION_CHANGE.q: What do you need from me?
REGION_CHANGE.a: Login, password and any email / authenticator codes during the process. Everything happens in the ticket — change your password right after.
Usually under 30 minutes. Steam rejects accounts that changed region within the last 3 months, so check before ordering.
